text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm coming in. Yoohoo, Trainer, how's it 
going?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. That's great to hear. Staying 
positive is what matters, no 
matter who 
you are.

Seiun Sky continues to look around the 
room restlessly, seemingly 
unable to relax.

At the very least, it's clear that something 
is bothering her.
choice_data_list: Shall we go get a change of pace?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Now this is a sight to see. Is my trainer 
suggesting we go play 
hooky?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like a plan, but what should we 
do? Sunbathing? Looking for 
cats? Or 
maybe, just maybe... fishing?

The two of us head out on a fishing trip. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You aren't very good at this, are 
you? Well, I guess I'm not one 
to talk 
either. Nya-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh. Do I look that way? Do I, 
now?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Let me give you some words of 
wisdom—"Love fish, but love fishing 
even 
more."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's not about what or how much you fish up. What's important is how you fish.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You can't just swing your rod haphazardly, 
nor can you rely on 
strength alone to reel. 
You have to keep thinking—keep trying 
new 
approaches.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Set your goal, collect intel, make 
preparations, and then try it out in
 
practice. By repeating this process, you 
learn what works and what 
doesn't.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And when the bait you've been prepping 
finally catches them hook, 
line, and 
sinker—it doesn't get better than that.
choice_data_list: It's a lot like how you run.
It's a lot like how you run.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. Which part?
choice_data_list: Trying all kinds of tricks to win.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Come on, what're you saying? I think you of all people would know this by now, but I'm not that great of a racer, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm the kid of some famous G1 
racer or anything... and I 
got a pretty 
dubious rep around the academy, too. 
There isn't a drop 
of ambition inside me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any lofty dreams. I just want 
to spend my days peacefully, 
whiling the 
time away fishing! That's the kind of life I 
live.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...The gold?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Wait a second... Are you really my 
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The trainer I know is a pushover rookie 
who lets me off the hook, no 
matter what I 
say. Right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me... Are you actually a 
doppelganger that arose from the 
swamp 
to take their place? Yikes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Right, of course... Then how come—
choice_data_list: I want to support you—as your Trainer.
Your Trainer who's cheering for you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Anyone ever tell you that you 
sometimes say the darndest 
things?

For a while, Seiun Sky and I simply sit 
together in silence with both 
our fishing 
lines cast into the water.
Some time passes...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You know... I get it, I really do. This is the 
part where I open up to 
you, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The part where I drop a sob story about 
how I'm not talented enough 
to reach my 
dreams, or that I just wasn't born with the 
right build to 
go pro.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But I still think it's... well, wouldn't it be 
boring for me to just put 
down my rod and 
give up?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I studied, pondered, pondered 
some more, and prepared 
all sorts of bait 
and techniques.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Then one day, I finally reeled in a big one. No one ever expected me to catch something that impressive!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was fun! I was on cloud nine! 
You should've seen everyone's 
faces, with 
their mouths hanging open in awe!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: They were all like, "She caught that?! But how?! There's just no way!"
choice_data_list: So that's where it all started for you.
So that's where it all started for you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder why.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I'm not really one for the 
overzealous sportsmanship. 
Y'know, 
passion, guts, hard work! ...All that 
exhausting hype.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But still, for some reason... I can't stop 
thinking about how I felt in 
that moment.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Just to be clear, I'm talking about 
fishing—but you knew that.
choice_data_list: Let's catch a big one together, then.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa there, me. Gotta go back to my 
happy-go-lucky mode.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't we go hit the training 
track? I suddenly have the urge 
to move 
my legs a bit.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
B-but don't get the wrong idea! I'm not 
saying I'll listen to your 
coaching from now 
on, or anything like that!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding. I tried to play coy there. 
How was that? Was I cute? 
Tee-hee! ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wha?! Wait a sec...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
For starters... you're gonna have to learn 
not to take my jokes at face 
value.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Please, I'm begging you. We gotta work on 
our coordination, don't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
After all, we're gonna need it to reel in a 
big one!

Later, Seiun Sky and I finally complete our 
first training session 
together.
